authority: implementation plan sections 7.2 item 6 and 11.2; experiment plan B1 with the recorded supersessions (wiki deviations 1-3)
status_note: FROZEN structure and floors; the dev-sequence names are filled by the paper-table selection rule below BEFORE any DiVa-360 data is inspected, then this file is committed again and hash-recorded in every census manifest

M1-A0.inputs: shipped fg/bg masks + 53-camera calibration + frozen tracks ONLY (no trained model anywhere)

M1-A0b.claim_limitation: M1 cannot support a claim-grade estimate of true-event absence or false-positive prevalence; recorded on the result page

M1-C.note: q-tilde distributions under M1-B snapshots; secondary diagnostic only, never gated

floors.derivation: two-proportion power analysis performed at M0 (prereg_metrics_v1.json power_analysis): detecting an arm difference of 0.5 vs 0.8 in per-event operation success at alpha=0.05 two-sided with power 0.8 needs n = 35.76 => 36 events per class per arm; the census floor is therefore 36 model-free opportunities per gated class over the dev subset
floors.reviewer_signoff: a fresh-context reviewer signs these floors BEFORE any DiVa-360 statistic is computed (plan 7.2 item 6)

true_absence_candidate.mask_disappearance: the object's fg-mask component vanishes from ALL cameras whose frustum contains its last triangulated position
true_absence_candidate.re_appearance_handling: a candidate ends at re-appearance; re-appearance within the sequence marks a same-object-return candidate

occlusion_event.definition: fg-mask component present in >= min_cameras but absent in >= 1 camera whose frustum contains the triangulated position for >= duration_floor_frames

same_object_return.definition: a true-absence candidate whose track identity re-appears within r_site of its disappearance position

audit_protocol.sample: all candidates up to 60 per dev subset, else stratified random 60 (strata: sequence x duration tercile; seed 20260811)
audit_protocol.auditors: two independent fresh-context audits per candidate, blinded to census outputs, tracks, and each other
audit_protocol.camera_rule: the 3 training cameras of maximal pairwise angular separation (ties by ascending camera id)
audit_protocol.verdict: confirmed only if both audits agree ABSENT; disagreement counts as unconfirmed (conservative)
audit_protocol.estimate: audited-confirmed count extrapolated by the sampling fraction with the one-sided lower Clopper-Pearson 90% bound

scene_selection.rule: dev subset = the first 3 hand-object interaction sequences in the official DiVa-360 paper sequence table (Table order, not data-inspected); calibration sequences = the next 2; held-out sequences and cameras never enter tracking, observability, or calibration
scene_selection.held_out_camera_rule: every camera id congruent to 0 mod 4 is held out from tracking/observability and reserved for evaluation
scene_selection.status: frozen rule; names filled at inventory from the paper table and committed before download completes

failure_retry_policy: implementation plan 11.2: a scientifically valid failure against these floors is the FINAL M1 result; replacement only for a verified technical or protocol-execution defect (post-outcome invalidations need fresh-context confirmation, max two); no revision-cycle mechanism exists

ceilings.preprocessing: reproducibility accounting only - projected and actual GPU-h, hardware provenance, processed scope; no hard ceiling
